description: Deterministic test vector for the x25519-hkdf-sha256-a256gcm/v1 EAB provisioning scheme (issue #42, WP1). Fixed ephemeral private key and nonce make the ciphertext reproducible; this file lets a browser WebCrypto implementation (internal/conductor/ui) be checked against the exact Go output. See pkg/api/v1alpha1/provisioning.go for the scheme and provisioning_test.go for the test that reads this file.
